subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**most**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the efficiency of the human circulatory system.
 
• The appropriate adjective should indicate the high level of efficiency of the system being described.
 
• "**Most**" fits well as it denotes a very high degree of efficiency, which aligns with the context of the passage.
 
• Other options ("**several**", "**many**", "**more**") do not fit the context of describing the very high efficiency of the circulatory system.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *One of the **most **efficient systems of the human body is the circulatory system. It is considered to be made up of complex and delicate blood vessels which transport blood to and from the heart. This system comprises arteries, veins and capillaries. The blood is pushed out of the heart to arteries under high pressure. Consequently, the arteries have thick and muscular veins. Veins bring blood from all parts of the body and work as the purifying channels in the system. Capillaries transfer blood from arteries to veins.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Several (कई): "Several" means more than two but not many, which does not effectively describe the high efficiency of the system.
 
• Many (कई): "Many" means a large number of, which is not suitable in this context to denote the highest degree of efficiency.
 
• More (अधिक): "More" means a greater amount, which implies comparison rather than denoting highest efficiency.
